reason: Waiting for Playwright's page.addLocatorHandler, which runs a handler when a locator is covered and waits for it to be hidden; Strider has no locator handler, so a check covered by an overlay can't be ported

An AbortSignal that is already aborted when the expectation starts fails it at once with the signal's reason, for toBeVisible and toHaveURL alike. Strider has no signal: an expectation that is interrupted before it starts never runs, so nothing fails with a message to assert. The matrix row says Strider cancels by interruption, which has no counterpart of an already-aborted signal
